title: Coffin-Iron Grappler
text: Coffin-Iron Grappler hooks intruders with riveted arms and drags them back across the seal line. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Every link in its chain remembers a prisoner.

defeatReward.text: Coffin-Iron Grappler is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
